quote: İkinci sorudan sonra da belirsizse görüşmeyi `not_reached` / `unclear` olarak kapatın.
rule: Only clear confirmations count; ask once more; after the second ask still unclear close not_reached/unclear.
defect: The ask count is not kept in code: the model decides via the extraction value 'unclear_again' ("the agent already asked twice") whether two asks happened, and max_node_turns 4 is a loose backstop. The model may close after one ask or keep asking.
fix: Add a code node after each non-confirming answer that increments an ask counter (e.g. vars['id_asks']) and routes to goodbye_short (unclear) when it reaches 2, re-asking with a fixed tts '{{addr}} ile mi görüşüyorum?' otherwise; do not count a turn where the agent only answered a question.

quote: Müşteri nasıl söylerse söylesin, doğum tarihini `YYYY-MM-DD` biçiminde gönderin.
rule: Two questions one at a time (DOB then phone last4); DOB sent as YYYY-MM-DD, digits read day-month-year.

quote: İkinci bir ret veya bu türden ikinci bir soru görüşmeyi kapatır.
rule: Refusal to answer: explain once; second refusal (or second 'what is this about') -> not_verified/declined.
defect: The identity node's max_node_turns (12) goes straight to goodbye_short while close_outcome/close_reason are still the setup defaults not_reached/unclear, so a confirmed customer who stalls in identity is closed as not_reached/unclear instead of not_verified/declined. The end_call tool in identity also lets the model end with that stale not_reached/unclear.
fix: Set close_outcome='not_verified', close_reason='declined' when entering identity (e.g. in a code node between opening and identity), and point identity.max_turn_transition to mark_declined.

quote: 1 ila 7 | early | bugünden sonraki 12. iş günü | 1
rule: Early band (1-7 days): deadline 12th business day after today, 1 persuasion attempt.

quote: 8 ila 45 | late | bugünden sonraki 7. iş günü | 2
rule: Late band (8-45 days): deadline 7th business day after today, 2 attempts.

quote: Yani Cuma günü söylenen "gelecek Cuma", takip eden haftanın Cuması'dır.
rule: 'Gelecek <day>' = that day next calendar week; 'bu <day>' = this week.

quote: Deneme 1: bu haftanın son iş gününü önerin. Bugün o gün ise, gelecek haftanın son iş gününü önerin.
rule: Attempt 1: last business day of this week (next week's if today), full or floor if too_much already said; attempt 2 (late only): floor on deadline.

quote: Denemeler tükendiğinde durun. Müşterinin zaten reddettiği bir teklifi tekrarlamayın. `no_promise` / `refused` olarak kapatın.
rule: Stop when attempts are used up; close no_promise/refused.
defect: The talk node exposes end_call to the model ('end_call right after a goodbye'), and close_outcome is preset to no_promise/refused in facts. The model can end the call after any refusal before the counted attempts in decide are used, so the attempt limit is not enforced by code.
fix: Remove end_call from talk (and hardship); let only the code-routed end_call nodes (goodbye_*) end the call.

quote: kısa bir başsağlığı/geçmiş olsun cümlesi söyleyin ve ikna denemesi yapmayın.
rule: Hardship: sympathy, no persuasion, offer support transfer; accept -> transfer support; decline -> no_promise/hardship; own date/amount still recorded.
defect: When the hardship customer names a date/amount, the hardship node goes to decide, which keeps the refusals counter and the persuasion logic. A later 'no' calls refuse(), which makes attempt 1/2 offers to a hardship customer and then closes as no_promise/refused instead of hardship.
fix: Set a hardship flag in hardship_prep; in decide, when the flag is set, never call refuse(): on 'no'/'stop' set dstate to end with close_reason 'hardship' (route to goodbye_hardship).

quote: Ürün başına bir söz. Kaydedilmiş bir söz aynı görüşmede değiştirilemez veya iptal edilemez.
rule: One promise per product; no change/cancel; refer to mobile app.

quote: Queue `restructuring` ile `transfer_to_agent` çağırın ve `transferred` / `restructuring` olarak kapatın.
rule: New plan / lower instalment -> transfer restructuring, close transferred/restructuring.
defect: If transfer_to_agent fails, the route falls to goodbye_short with close_outcome still no_promise/refused (set in facts), a reason the brief does not give for this case.
fix: On transfer failure, retry once (maxRetries 1) and route to a node that tells the customer the transfer could not be made and sets an explicit close outcome (e.g. no_promise/service_error) before ending.

quote: önce yardımcı olup olamayacağınızı bir kez sorun. Ayrıca ısrar ederse, queue `general` ile `transfer_to_agent` çağırın
rule: Person request: ask once if you can help; on insistence transfer general, close transferred/human (before and after verification).
defect: The 'ask once' is not counted: every new request re-enters wants_human and asks 'Size ben yardımcı olabilir miyim?' again instead of transferring. Also max_node_turns 3 sends to transfer_human even without insistence. If the transfer fails, goodbye_short closes with whatever stale outcome is set (e.g. not_reached/unclear in opening/identity, no_promise/refused in talk).
fix: Keep a code counter vars['human_asked']; on the second request go straight to transfer_human. Set max_turn_transition to __previous__. On transfer failure, set an explicit close outcome before ending.

quote: Müşteri görüşmek istemediğini iki kez söylerse, `no_promise` / `refused` olarak kapatın. Kimlik doğrulanmadan önce aynı müşteri `not_verified` / `declined` olarak kapatılır.
rule: Twice 'don't want to talk' -> no_promise/refused; before verification -> not_verified/declined.
defect: After verification it is counted (stop_count). Before verification there is no 'stop' extraction in opening: a confirmed-or-not caller who says twice they don't want to talk runs to max_node_turns and closes as not_reached/unclear, and in identity, after the 12-turn limit, the close falls to the stale not_reached/unclear.
fix: Add a 'stop' value to the opening/identity extractions, count it in code, and route the second one to mark_declined (not_verified/declined).

quote: Her görüşme, bir sonuçla ve tabloda listelenmişse bir nedenle, tam olarak bir `close_call` ile biter. Bu, son araç çağrısıdır.
rule: Exactly one close_call, last tool call, with correct outcome/reason.
defect: close_call runs at end_of_call with whatever close_outcome/close_reason is in vars. Conversation nodes give the model an end_call tool, so the model can end at any point with a stale pair (e.g. not_reached/unclear inside identity after confirmation, no_promise/refused in talk before attempts are used).
fix: Remove end_call from conversation nodes. End calls only through code-routed goodbye_* nodes, each set by a mark_* node that writes the outcome/reason.

quote: | `promise` | yok | en az bir söz kaydedildi |
rule: promise outcome without reason when a promise is recorded.
